# Scenario X06 — Sales / Product / Engineering Disagreement

**Domain:** B2B SaaS. **Situation:** conflicting stakeholders.

## Context

A B2B SaaS company ("Compass," an applicant tracking system) is deciding whether to build
direct integration with a popular recruiting marketplace. Sales is pushing hard: the last
three enterprise deals all asked for it, and one will sign this quarter if it ships. Product
is skeptical the marketplace matters to the core SMB segment and wants to see evidence of
demand beyond "three sales calls said yes." Engineering says the integration is expensive (a
new OAuth partner, ongoing sync maintenance) and estimates it displaces a migration project
the platform team has committed to.

The three sides are arguing past each other: Sales cites deal pressure, Product cites segment
fit, Engineering cites cost. The meeting has stalled twice.

## Inputs available (imperfect)

- Three enterprise prospects asked for the integration (sales-call notes).
- No data on how many existing customers use the marketplace at all.
- No win/loss evidence linking the marketplace to churn or to deal velocity.
- Engineering cost estimate exists but no cost-benefit framing.

## Ask

You have one page to recommend what the team should do and how to resolve the disagreement.
State your reasoning and the evidence you are relying on or missing.
